verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend. Out-of-pocket reimbursement is a fair question for a spend-management card product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only cashback rates, partner perks, points redemption and card requests, with nothing on submitting out-of-pocket expenses, direct-deposit payouts or tracking from submission to payout. The 'withdraw it from the app' line appears to refer to rewards, not reimbursements.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout
